## Claims
- [source-backed] For \(a=\min(n-r-i,r-j)\), \(b=\min(i,j)\), each Theorem 5.4 Schur generating set has \(N=\binom{a+b}{a}\) elements; the paper reports verification only for \(r\le4\) and \(n-r\le5\). [source-2, lines 1382-1421; source-2, lines 1495-1502]
- [computed] For the in-box case \((r,n-r,i,j)=(4,5,2,2)\), \(a=b=2\), \(N=6\), and the computed \(Q=J_v/\Lambda_+J_v\) has rank \(6\), no torsion invariant factors, and \(\mu_{\mathbb Z}(Q)=6=N\). [artifact c888fc1cb70729a52fc6755f3631cf7884919abad2ced7ea9ef405adb67f2e99]
- [computed] For the first \(r\)-boundary case outside the reported box, \((r,n-r,i,j)=(5,1,1,1)\), \(a=0,b=1,N=1\); \(Q\) has rank \(1\), no torsion invariant factors, and \(\mu_{\mathbb Z}(Q)=1=N\). [artifact c888fc1cb70729a52fc6755f3631cf7884919abad2ced7ea9ef405adb67f2e99]
- [computed] For the nontrivial outside-\(r\) case \((r,n-r,i,j)=(5,2,1,1)\), \(a=b=1,N=2\); \(Q\) has rank \(2\), no torsion invariant factors, and \(\mu_{\mathbb Z}(Q)=2=N\). [artifact c888fc1cb70729a52fc6755f3631cf7884919abad2ced7ea9ef405adb67f2e99]
- [computed] For the first \(n-r\)-boundary case outside the reported box, \((r,n-r,i,j)=(1,6,1,1)\), \(a=0,b=1,N=1\); \(Q\) has rank \(1\), no torsion invariant factors, and \(\mu_{\mathbb Z}(Q)=1=N\). [artifact c888fc1cb70729a52fc6755f3631cf7884919abad2ced7ea9ef405adb67f2e99]
- [conjectural] These finite torsion-free examples support, but do not prove, \(Q\cong\mathbb Z^N\) or \(\mu_{\mathbb Z}(Q)=N\) in all admissible cases.

## Strategy
Use integral presentations of \(Q\), compute Smith normal form, and compare rank and torsion-sensitive \(\mu_{\mathbb Z}(Q)\) with \(N=\binom{a+b}{a}\). The reported sample includes one in-box case and boundary cases outside each coordinate of \(r\le4,\ n-r\le5\).

## Gaps
The computation is finite and does not establish the conjecture universally. No nontrivial (\(N>1\)) case with \(n-r>5\) was computed in the supplied artifact.

## Next
Compute a nontrivial \(n-r>5\) example and further cases with \(r>5\), retaining full Smith-normal-form artifacts.
